flags: Kiger Aug 2026 hike: source (v3cars) identifies only the month (Aug 2026), not the day; effective_date recorded as 2026-08-01 as an approximation. Dual-tone variants' post-hike prices were not broken out in the source; assumed to follow the same +Rs 4,000-5,000 hike but not recorded.

Kiger verifiedData (lastVerifiedAt 2026-10-12) carries pre-Aug-2026-hike prices for eight variants: Evolution MT 655000, Techno MT 755000, Emotion MT 845000, Evolution AMT 699000, Techno AMT 805000, Emotion Turbo MT 935000, Techno Turbo CVT 935000, Emotion Turbo CVT 1035000. Autocar (Oct 8, 2026) confirms the range now runs to Rs 10.40 lakh, matching the hiked figures recorded here; verified data appears stale on these variants.

Kiger entry price path: facelift launch 6.29L (Aug 24, 2025) -> GST cut 5,76,300 (Sep 22, 2025) -> ~5.81L by mid-2026 after the Jan 2026 up-to-2% hike (variant-wise figures never disclosed). Current entry 5.81L corroborated by Autocar (Oct 8, 2026), IndiaTV (Sep 2026) and verifiedData.

Duster launch headline price Rs 10.29 lakh was the R-Pass introductory price (till Mar 31, 2026); standard entry Rs 10.49 lakh. Recorded launch_price_inr as 1029000 (at-launch headline) with the standard price noted.
Duster Adventure Edition launched Jul 17, 2026 from Rs 12.99 lakh (v3cars) is a special edition - excluded from launches per rules.

Duster strong-hybrid (1.8L E-Tech, 160 PS combined) prices NOT announced as of 2026-10-12; Renault committed to reveal prices by Diwali 2026 (~Nov 2026). Pre-bookings for the hybrid closed; turbo-petrol deliveries ongoing. Strong-hybrid launch will be a future launch event.
Kiger facelift launch entry price Rs 6.29L is media-reported (TOI, CarDekho, HT Auto); a manufacturer press-release figure for the entry variant was not separately verified.

launches.notes: First major midlife refresh since 2021 launch. Prices Rs 6.29-11.29 lakh ex-showroom at launch (Rs 14,000 up on the Rs 6.15 lakh pre-facelift start). Four trims: Authentic, Evolution, Techno, Emotion; six airbags standard, new grille/bumpers/LED lighting, 1.0L NA and turbo-petrol carry over.

Third-generation Duster (RGMP platform), nameplate returns after 2022 exit; India never got gen-2. Unveiled Jan 26, 2026. Rs 10.29 lakh was R-Pass introductory price valid till Mar 31, 2026; standard entry price Rs 10.49 lakh from Apr 1, 2026. Entry variant: Authentic Turbo TCe 100 MT.

model_notes.note: GST 2.0 revision effective 2025-09-22: Renault passed the full GST benefit; entire Kiger range cut Rs 53,695-96,395 (5.1%-8.5%); entry Authentic MT Rs 6,29,995 to Rs 5,76,300; top Emotion Turbo CVT Rs 11,29,995 to Rs 10,33,600. Sources: HT Auto, DriveSpark, NewsBytes. This was the 22 Sep GST revision (2025), not 2026.

Renault announced an up-to-2% price hike from January 2026 across Kwid, Triber and Kiger to offset rising input costs (DriveSpark, Dec 27 2025). Variant-wise breakup was not disclosed, so no per-variant price_changes records were created for it.

2026-06-24: Renault added four new Kiger variants - Evolution+ NA MT (Rs 6.99L), Evolution+ AMT (Rs 7.49L), Evolution+ Turbo MT (Rs 7.89L), Techno Turbo MT (Rs 8.50L); turbo range repriced Rs 7.89-10.35L ex-showroom, now the cheapest turbo sub-compact SUV. Source: ETAuto. New-variant additions, not revisions of existing variants.

R-Pass pre-booking benefit: introductory pricing Rs 10.29-18.09 lakh (valid till Mar 31, 2026); standard pricing Rs 10.49-18.49 lakh from Apr 1, 2026. 39% of metro bookings were for the upcoming strong-hybrid; 91% of all bookings were for the TCe 160 (163 PS) turbo-petrol. Source: Autocar India.

Duster prices unchanged through Sep-Oct 2026: range Rs 10.49-18.49 lakh ex-showroom (IndiaTV, Sep 11 2026; dailyjagran, Oct 8 2026; Autocar, Oct 8 2026). Launched post-GST-2.0, so no GST revision applied.
